title: Police Showed Up At His Door After He Assaulted A Nurse At The Hospital
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On October 2nd 2023. Officers were dispatched to a hospital regarding a man had assaulted, and taken a picture of one of the nurses working there. After reviewing the clinic's security footage, officers made their way to a residence to get his side of the story.
